Scope: sports grounds (padel, basketball and football), a service and toilet building, landscape works, bike and walking paths, and parking at three sites in Asir, Jazan and Jeddah.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. The project is at 50.9% against 64.1% planned, 13.3% behind (SPI 0.79). It gained 4.7% this week against 2.1% planned, so the gap narrowed from 15.8% on 09-Nov-2026. Each site gained about 6% of its own scope; Jazan is still furthest behind at 37.1% against 57.7% planned.

Project completion is now forecast 134 days late. The weekly report and the P6 update (data date 16-Nov-2026) both forecast completion on 08-Jun-2027, 6 days later than on 09-Nov-2026 and 134 days after the contract completion date of 25-Jan-2027. P6 shows −108 days of float on project completion and 264 open activities with negative float. Despite the stronger week, every open milestone except the toilet building slipped another 6 days. The critical path still runs through the air dome: on the most critical of the three domes, approval of the PVC membrane, steel tension cables, emergency doors, lock doors and wire mesh has still not started; it has been moved again, to 16–23 Nov-2026, and carries −108 days of float.

Work reported this weekThe works-done file lists, without quantities: football and basketball court slabs cast in Asir; air dome foundations finished and steelwork for the glass front under way at all sites; irrigation pipes laid in Asir and Jeddah; ceramic tiling of the toilets under way at all sites; curbs around the courts finished in Jeddah; facade stone on the toilets finished in Asir and Jazan; trenching, cables and bases for light poles at all three sites; walkway backfilling and compaction; the Jazan water tank cast and cured; and roof waterproofing of the toilets at all sites.
Quantities this week and behind planFour items moved: water supply piping +124 LM (now complete at 138 LM), ceiling finishes +207 m² (complete), irrigation HDPE pipe +4,000 m and site lighting poles +120. Still behind the plan to date: sewer and drainage pipe at 55 of 177 LM, 150 mm uPVC pipe at 50 of 150 m, irrigation pipe at 4,000 of 5,000 m, lighting poles at 120 of 180 and earthworks at 57,000 of 57,844 m³. Hardscape, trees, the air dome, site furniture, ceramic tiles and lighting fixtures are still at 0, although tiling is reported under way.

Jazan sets the finish date. Jazan works and project completion share the latest forecast, 08-Jun-2027, at −108 days of float. Every open milestone except the toilet building slipped another 6 days since 09-Nov; project finish moved from 02-Jun to 08-Jun-2027. The toilet building moved the other way, from 25-Jan-2027 to 22-Dec-2026, and now has 29 days of float. Open activities with negative float are led by furniture (18), electrical works (14), steel tension cables (12), emergency doors (11) and pressure units (11). * The testing and commissioning baseline of 29-Apr-2026 is as given in the Milestones sheet and appears to be wrong.

No new risk and issue log was uploaded; the latest, of 26-Oct, has 9 open risks, six rated High (air-dome delivery delay, air quality in confined spaces, equipment maintenance and certification, fall protection, heat stress, separation of public traffic), two Medium (unauthorised site entry, unsafe material storage) and one Low (defective tools). The weekly report's works-done file names air dome supply as the project's challenge.

Data notes

  • Basis for this week's change: the "last week" columns of the 16-Nov-2026 report (224,374.5 planned and 181,205.9 earned man-hours) are still the 26-Oct-2026 values, so its "weekly" +6.26% against +8.90% covers three weeks. Against the 09-Nov-2026 report (251,996.4 planned, 187,741.8 earned) the week's change is +4.65% against +2.10% planned, which is used here.
  • The Physical-Chart Data sheet gives the November achieved value as 64.13% (260,522.6 man-hours), which is the planned value at 16-Nov-2026; last week the October row had the same error. The S-curve uses 50.9% for November.
  • Levelling works: the Milestones sheet shows the milestone achieved on 13-Oct-2026, although last week's report forecast it for 10-Nov-2026; the P6 update and the look-ahead still show it not achieved, forecast 16-Nov-2026 with −6 days of float.
  • The report week is the project week counted from site handover (26-Mar-2026 to 16-Nov-2026 is 235 days, week 33). The files carry the serial WPR-29 but state no week number.
  • Repeated files: the Procurement Log uploaded this week is byte-identical to the 26-Oct-2026 (WPR-26) log, and the file "08 … Progress Report" is byte-identical to the WPR-25 file of 19-Oct-2026. The Procurement sheet is unchanged. No risk and issue log was uploaded.
  • Safety figures disagree: the report summary gives 132,050 cumulative and 6,480 man-hours for the week (the 26-Oct values); the HSE statistics sheet gives 155,760 and 4,560, still under a heading of 06–13 Oct 2026, and its cumulative rose 18,490 since 09-Nov. Equipment is 10 against 8 planned in the Manpower sheet and 3 against 2 in the summary.
  • The Major Quantity Trackers block of the summary sheet has its labels shifted by one row (for example 138 LM shown against sewer and drainage pipe); this report uses the Major Quantities sheet.
  • The works-done file (16) carries another project's header data: central sector, project manager Abdullah Al-Shunaifi, contractor Al-Injaz, and dates of 24-Nov-2025 to 23-May-2026. Files 15 and 16, the Look Ahead and Conclusion sheets and the Tracking Progress file label a cost-based progress figure as "actual"; this report uses physical progress (man-hour weighted) only.
  • The Issues sheet marks the MV cable issue completed (17-Oct-2026) while its text says the risk remains open and another line lists "MV Network" as open.
  • The NCR count is corrected to 33 issued, 26 closed and 5 pending (earlier reports had 33 closed against 23 issued), but 2 NCRs are still unaccounted for.
  • The schedule statistics now match the UPS-29 XER (1,792 completed, 20 in progress, 322 not started); the report counts 265 critical activities against 264 open activities with negative float in the XER, and the Failed Start List header is still dated 05-Oct-2026.
  • Still uncorrected from earlier reports: the Milestones sheet's baseline dates for programme approval (02-Jun-2026), mobilisation (25-Jan-2027) and testing and commissioning (29-Apr-2026); the Conclusion sheet's project end of 25-Jan-2026; and the Conclusion sheet's supply summary (interlock 4,000 of 8,500, curbs 8,000 of 11,000), which does not match the Procurement Log.
